Rates of Import Duty. The articles specifically listed in Annex A
hereof, as classified in compliance with Section 1611 of RA No. 10863, shall be subject
to the MN rates of duty in accordance with the schedule indicated opposite the

MN Tariff Rate Adjustment. The MN rates of duty on rice, both
in-quota and out-quota, under EO No. 62 shall be maintained until 31 December 2025.
Beginning 01 January 2026, the MFN rates of duty on rice shall be: (a)
increased by five (5) percentage points per five percent (5%) decrease in international
rice prices; or (b) decreased by five (5) percentage points per five percent (5%)
increase in international rice prices. However, the MN rates of duty on rice, both
in-quota and out-quota, shall in no case be below 15% or above 35%.

Inter-Agency Group on Rice Tariff Adjustment. An Inter-Agency
Group on Rice Tariff Adjustment ("Inter-Agency Group") is hereby created. It shall be
composed of representatives from the following: (a) DEPDev; (b) Department of
Agriculture (DA); (c) Department of Trade and Industry; (d) Department of Finance;
and (e) Office of the Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic
The Inter-Agency Group is hereby directed to formulate the guidelines
necessary to implement this Order. Said guidelines shall include, among others, the
determination of the thresholds, certification by the DA that said thresholds or trigger
price levels have been reached, monitoring period, and other relevant details
regarding the adjustment of the MN rates of duty on rice under Sections 1 and 2

Repeal. EO No. 62 is hereby amended. All other issuances,
administrative rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this
Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision or part of this Order is declared invalid
or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid and
subsisting.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect 15 days after its complete
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this
Year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Five.
7th day of November
By the President:
